provenance.note: BMC's own flood-spot register (~110 chronic/monitored spots with official names, wards, coordinates, AWS station ids), replacing the earlier hand-curated press layer. The FULL pre-monsoon list (496 spots in 2026) is not published with locations - a named gap. Weekly cron (bmc-floodspots-refresh.yml) writes through scripts/nvdm_write.py so this envelope survives the rewrite.

name: mumbai-flood-hotspots
_provenance: BMC Disaster Management flood-spot register (dmwebtwo.mcgm.gov.in floodSpot/loadAll, fetched 2026-08-31): the officially mapped chronic/monitored subset of the city's pre-monsoon flooding-spot list, with BMC's own names, wards and coordinates; each spot is tied to an automatic weather station. The FULL pre-monsoon list (496 spots in 2026) is not published with locations.
